discovery_confirm.description: Give your fireplace a name. Read-only mode blocks all setting writes. If disabled, RF-initiated operation can override Wi-Fi commands, including Off. Do not rely on unattended shutdown automations.

user.description: Enter the details of your fireplace. Read-only mode blocks all setting writes. If disabled, RF-initiated operation can override Wi-Fi commands, including Off. Do not rely on unattended shutdown automations.

data_description.unique_id: Use the dongle's lowercase MAC address (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff), not its IP address. Keep this identity when changing networks.

reconfigure.description: Change the host, port, or read-only mode without changing device identity. Disabling read-only permits setting writes, but does not override the RF remote. RF-initiated operation can overwrite commands, including Off. Do not rely on unattended shutdown automations.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect and receive a Proflame state snapshot.

abort.not_proflame_device: The device did not provide an acknowledged Proflame state.
